---

Resolve a list of fern and lycophyte species names against the current
[PPG classification](ppg.qmd): names are matched to PPG (allowing for minor
spelling and author-citation differences), and synonyms are resolved to their
accepted names. Matching is done by the
[taxastand](https://github.com/joelnitta/taxastand) R package, which runs
**entirely in your browser** (via [webR](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/)).
Your names are never sent to a server.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## How to Use

1. Wait for the status bar to say **Ready** (the first visit has to load R,
   which can take a minute).
2. Type or paste species names, one per line, or upload a `.txt`, `.csv` or
   `.tsv` file. For a table with several columns, choose the column that
   contains the names. Authors are optional, but help distinguish homonyms.
3. Adjust the options if needed, then click **Resolve names**.
4. Click a column header to sort the results. Download them as CSV with
   **Download results (CSV)**; the file also records the PPG version and DOI.

Row colors: yellow rows are fuzzy or genus-corrected matches (check these
before use), blue rows have multiple hits, and red rows are unresolved.

### Notes

- The first visit downloads the R runtime and packages (a few tens of MB), which
  your browser then caches. Only the PPG data for the genera in your list is
  downloaded.
- Only the species name and, optionally, authors need to be given; infraspecific
  names (e.g. *Genus species* var. *variety*) are supported. Names with only a
  genus cannot be resolved.
- Fuzzy matching only happens **within** a genus: if the genus is misspelled, the
  name is reported as "genus not found", with suggestions.
- **Match type** values are those of
  [taxastand](https://joelnitta.github.io/taxastand/reference/ts_match_names.html#match-types-1)
  (`exact`, `auto_punct`, `auto_fuzzy`, …). `no_match` means no name in PPG was
  close enough. If a name matches several names that resolve to *different*
  accepted names (e.g. the same name published by different authors), it is
  listed as "multiple hits" and left unresolved; use "Show all" to see each hit.
- Names given without authors are matched with authors ignored if the full-name
  match fails, so that small spelling differences are still found.
- Always check fuzzy matches (`auto_fuzzy`) before using them.

If you use this tool, please cite the PPG version shown on the Name Resolver tab (with its DOI)
and [taxastand](https://github.com/joelnitta/taxastand).
